name: How long does a tub-to-shower conversion typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a tub-to-shower conversion typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a tub-to-shower conversion can vary depending on the complexity of the project and the materials chosen. A standard conversion, which involves removing the old tub and installing a new shower pan, walls, and fixtures, typically takes about 3 to 5 days. More involved projects, such as those requiring significant plumbing relocation or custom tile work, might extend the timeline. We strive to complete projects efficiently to minimize disruption to your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: A standard tub-to-shower conversion usually takes 3 to 5 days, though complex projects may take longer.
